name: SDF Normal Estimation via Finite Differences
aliases: SDF Gradient Estimation via Central Differences
Isosurface Normal Estimation via Central Differences
definition: Estimating the surface normal by calculating the gradient of the SDF numerically using finite differences, since SDF surfaces have no explicit mesh normals.
summary: SDF Normal Estimation via Finite Differences computes surface normals by numerically approximating the gradient of the distance function using central differences, avoiding the need for explicit mesh data.
